transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the power-management plan sorted for tomorrow's 0800 to 1400 period. We have three two-hour blocks available: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1200-1400. The facilities shop, clinic, and protected-network section all need an approved block or operating control before the period begins. I'd like each section to present their requirements so we can work through this at the coordination board and I can approve the final plan. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Harper, before we go further, I need to flag something. I confirmed this morning that the east distribution panel must be taken offline for the generator load test from exactly 0800 to 1000 tomorrow. The electrical contractor's signed work sheet is in the facilities binder, but it hasn't been added to the coordination-board slide yet. This means the facilities shop has a hard requirement on the 0800-1000 block.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I need to flag a clinic requirement that isn't in the base power plan yet. I confirmed with our pharmacy technician that the clinic's vaccine refrigerator must remain on generator-backed power during the exact 1000-1200 block tomorrow, while its primary feed is transferred. This note came in after yesterday's clinic report, so it hasn't been reflected in the coordination-board materials yet. The clinic has a hard requirement on the 1000-1200 block for generator-backed power.
